A '''space-freighter's hangout''' was a popular [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] among [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was involved in a brawl in this hangout along with several other patrons, including a [[Unidentified Revwien (space-freighter)|Revwien]]. Following this, the local schoolboy [[Berd Lin]] burst in, recruiting many of patrons in an effort to rescue his [[Myoris Lin|mother]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces arresting her.
